VIDEO_DEVICES_FOUND.note: Eight enumerated sources are not eight independent physical cameras. Built-in and virtual/screen sources were enumerated only.

ROBOT_CAMERAS_CONFIRMED.evidence: Three unique external device IDs successfully selected and captured; visually distinct views of the paper/tool/palette setup
ROBOT_CAMERAS_CONFIRMED.three_way_simultaneous_capture: NOT_PROVEN: 5MP capture failed during concurrent attempt, succeeded alone; root cause UNKNOWN
ROBOT_CAMERAS_CONFIRMED.limitations: Brief snapshots, not a sustained-stream bandwidth test or optical calibration

tool_camera.useful_robot_context: YES: close tool/brush view; arm/base not visible
tool_camera.observation: Brush tip enters from bottom over paper; broad blank local area and paper edges visible; tip is soft/out of focus; full paper outline not visible
tool_camera.role_evidence: Primary view shows tool tip and paper together

paper_context_camera.useful_robot_context: NO: no identifiable tool tip or gripper
paper_context_camera.observation: Broad white paper area with some boundary/table context; no identifiable tool tip
paper_context_camera.role_evidence: Secondary context view of paper; no left/right mounting claim

palette_context_camera.useful_robot_context: LIMITED: small tool tip at top edge; arm/base not visible
palette_context_camera.observation: Oblique/rolled palette and partial white work-surface view; window/wall occupy much of frame; brush tip near top edge; intended drawing zone not sufficiently framed
palette_context_camera.role_evidence: Palette/context view only; actual side mounting is not independently established

WHY: 1080p InnoMaker shows paper and brush tip together with a clear local drawing area. 720p supplies additional paper context. 5MP palette-dominated framing is weaker for drawing control.
readiness_scope: YES for basic image observation and dry-run action proposals using visible local paper and tip. Exact paper-center localization, contact clearance, focus at the tip and physical motion readiness remain unverified.
recommended_adjustments: Improve 1080p focus at the brush tip and include the full paper outline for center-relative positioning
If a contact-clearance view is needed, reframe the 5MP camera on the tip and paper plane instead of the palette/window
logical_name_scope: Aliases describe evidenced image roles, not unverified physical left/right mounts. Revalidate after reconnection; USB location-derived unique IDs may change. 5MP unique ID changed since the previous session.
camera_capture_method: Exact AVFoundation unique ID plus exact localizedName; no FFmpeg numeric-index selection
